MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo accurately reflects that this is an amendment document which does not contain the fundamental economic terms of the underlying credit facility (interest rates, loan amounts, maturity dates, etc.). The memo appropriately captures all the key financial terms that ARE present in the source document:

- Amendment date (November 30, 2021)
- Original credit agreement date (June 11, 2021)
- Borrower name (America First Multifamily Investors, L.P.)
- Lender names (BankUnited, N.A., Bankers Trust Company)
- Administrative Agent (BankUnited, N.A.)
- Guarantor (Greystone Select Incorporated)
- Collateral description (first priority perfected liens)
- Complex organizational structure details

The memo also correctly notes where information is not available ("N/A") and explicitly states that the amendment does not contain fundamental economic terms, which would require review of the original credit agreement. This is an accurate and complete representation of the financial terms actually present in the source document.
